mutations.name: Jcode host applies the requested reasoning effort to its session
mutations.expectRed: requested variant reaches the session as its reasoning effort

mutations.name: Jcode host refuses the launch when the provider rejects the tier
mutations.find: throw new Error(`jcode connector: reasoning effort ${JSON.stringify(config.variant)} was refused for model ${JSON.stringify(model ?? "(the provider default)")} — ${(error as Error).message}`);
mutations.expectRed: a tier the provider refuses ends the launch
